authority.scope: close the TCP 11435 integrity defect; revalidate identity before acting; least-forceful termination of the orphan only

classification.rationale: A second ollama started by hand over SSH and reparented to init when the session closed. The governed instance is a separate process under ollama.service on 11434. The absent_listeners policy was correct and detected this in 19 seconds; it is not the stale artifact.

consumers_of_11435_in_repository: apps/nemotron-worker/nemotron_worker.py (NEMOTRON_LISTEN_PORT default), whose unit dominion-nemotron.service is inactive and disabled
blast_radius.assessment: The system ran without this process for weeks before 2026-09-09T21:16:51Z. No active unit consumes 11435.
blast_radius.residual_risk: An unrecorded VM-side consumer configured outside the repository could exist. Mitigated by requiring the integrity agent to return PASS and the Command Center to stay green as post-state proofs.

revalidation_before_action: target discovered from the listener, never from the remembered pid
executable SHA-256 equals the recorded hash
cgroup is a user session scope; a target under system.slice is refused
governed ollama on 11434 is a distinct pid under ollama.service answering HTTP 200

rollback.path: The removed process is a stateless model server started manually. Recovery is to start a second instance again with OLLAMA_HOST bound to 127.0.0.1:11435. No data is destroyed and the governed instance on 11434 is untouched throughout.

verification.critical_guard_proven: a target under system.slice is refused, so no governed unit can be terminated by this lane
